<!--
What:  GitHub PR template for RRMS. Auto-loads into the PR description box
       when contributors open a new PR. Forces a per-PR doc-impact checklist
       so spec / plan / ADR drift cannot slip through unreviewed.
Why:   Tactic 2 of the four anti-doc-debt tactics from the 2026-05-10
       pre-Plan-2 audit. The 2026-05-09 consistency-audit found 21 issues
       caused by un-disciplined edits after the Auth.js → Better Auth
       pivot — every issue would have been caught at PR-open time if the
       reviewer (and the author) had been forced to tick "checked spec
       impact / checked Plans 1-8 references / pnpm audit:docs passed".
Where: .github/pull_request_template.md (GitHub auto-loads it).
When:  Every PR open after Phase 2A merges.
-->

## 變動摘要

<!-- 1-3 sentences: what changed and why. -->

## Spec / Plan / ADR 影響清單

對應 `feedback_per_plan_mini_audit.md` 紀律。**每個 PR 必須勾完底下所有 N/A 之外的項目**。

- [ ] spec（`docs/superpowers/specs/`）章節是否需對應修改？_列章節：_
- [ ] Plans 1-8（`docs/superpowers/plans/`）是否引用本 PR 變動？_列 plan + line：_
- [ ] 對應 brainstorm 決議的 ADR：_ADR-XXXX_（若新增決議：已建立 ADR-XXXX）
- [ ] `pnpm audit:docs` 通過（CI 也會擋；本機先跑）
- [ ] `CODING_STANDARDS.md` / `README.md` 是否需更新？

## Plan 對應 mini-audit（per-Plan PR 才需）

<!-- 若本 PR 是 Plan PR（feat/plan-N-...），附 mini-audit 報告連結或內聯 -->

- [ ] mini-audit 報告路徑：`docs/superpowers/research/2026-05-XX-plan-N-mini-audit.md`
- [ ] mini-audit 顯示 0 critical / 0 high
- [ ] 任何 medium / low 已記錄處置

## Test plan

<!-- 列具體本機驗證步驟。CI 跑的 lint/typecheck/scan 之外還跑了什麼？ -->

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm audit:docs`
- [ ] （如有 schema 變動）`pnpm db:generate` 後 staging Neon branch dry-run
- [ ] （如有 server action 變動）相關 Playwright 測試 PASS
- [ ] （如有 client UI 變動）`pnpm dev` 開瀏覽器確認

## Branch protection 提示

依 [`feedback_pr_flow.md`](https://github.com/BigMikeTW/rrms/blob/main/docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-10-pre-plan-2-rigorous-foundation.md) 規則：

- Plan 1 + Plan 8 = 人工 merge
- Plan 2-7 + foundation phases = `gh pr merge <#> --auto --merge`
- 直接 push main = 已被 branch protection 擋

🤖 Generated by Phase 2A of [pre-Plan-2 rigorous foundation](https://github.com/BigMikeTW/rrms/blob/main/docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-10-pre-plan-2-rigorous-foundation.md)
